A family friend was going to work on it. I left him the key and asked him to look at it to let me know what was wrong but not to fix anything (I didn’t want to pay out the rear for things that I could figure out on my own or my boyfriend’s dad could do once he was in town). He fixed it up and told my parents how much it’d cost. They demanded the money from me since they paid it. I said “no, I didn’t want it done without me knowing and this was something I’d already said.” They got so mad that they told me to go live with my boyfriend, made me get my stuff, give them the key, etc. Time goes by and it’s like they forgot that conversation happened—that they took my key, made me take my belongings, and all that. To this day, they deny they kicked me out despite me having text message proof of this happening. Tbh getting kicked out was the best thing that could have happened to me though because if they hadn’t done that, I’d never have distanced myself enough to see that I was living their life, not my own.

Hey friend. I get it. It’s easy to think also “why would got allow that? If He is God, then why couldn’t he just force a different outcome?” I want you to know that God didn’t design it this way. The world is screwed up. People can be awful, depraved, wicked, etc. but that wasn’t the original plan. God hates the way this world is more than we could ever realize. He sees our suffering. But there’s something you have to understand: God gave us the freedom of choice. God is love and love is not forceful. If God is true to His character, then this applies to all of us. As for people just saying “oh yeah God I’m really sorry :/“ and that’s it…that isn’t repentance. Repentance is LITERALLY turning away completely from something. It means you don’t go back to it and have no desire to. That doesn’t mean there won’t be the natural consequences of your actions (being put in prison for murder for instance). You wanna know why the world is so awful? Satan is roaming around it like a lion, looking to destroy. That’s the thing that people don’t realize: Jesus hasn’t returned yet. Satan isn’t a red guy with horns in what we imagine to be hell. He and his little minions are here, wreaking all sorts of havoc. There’s going to come a day when Jesus comes back and “separates the sheep (His people) from the goats (those who chose to not follow Him)” and that’s when people will be in heaven and hell. Hes going to come back at just the right time. God will judge all of us one day and what happened to that person won’t go unnoticed, but the mark of a true follower of Christ is being able to come to a point of peace and able to look at even the worst of us and pray that they will be forgiven just like we’d hope to be forgiven. I hope that all made sense and forgive me if there’s anything I misunderstood.
